intents.intent: Repair action execution system. Coordinates lock, backup, dispatch, and finalization phases for applying agent responses to the codebase. Delegates to _prepare_apply, _dispatch_repairs, and _finalize_apply.
Orchestrate applying an agent response by delegating to preparation, dispatch, and finalization phases. Manages lock lifecycle.
Validate graph version, acquire lock, collect files to modify, check for conflicts, and create backups before applying repairs.
Iterate over repair actions in the agent response and dispatch each to the appropriate handler (connect_call, add_import, remove_dead_code, flag_for_review).
Format modified files, apply intents and workflow suggestions, update graph1, validate modified files, and save undo information.
AST extraction engine (Graph_0). Parses Python source files and delegates to language-specific extractors via the registry for JS/TS/React files.
Extract the complete Graph_0 for a project. Initializes extractor registry, discovers source files across all supported languages, and delegates non-Python files to registered language extractors.

JavaScript/TypeScript/React extractor. Regex-based parser that extracts function declarations, arrow functions, React components, class methods, hooks, and import edges from JS/TS/JSX/TSX source files.
Parse a JS/TS source file using regex patterns to produce Graph0Node objects for functions, arrow functions, React components, class methods, and hooks.
Extract import-type WorkflowEdge objects from JS/TS source by parsing import/require statements and resolving relative import paths to actual file locations.
Resolve a JS import specifier (relative path like ./components/Button) to a project-relative file path by trying common extensions (.ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx) and index file variants.
Generate candidate file paths for a JS import by appending common extensions (.ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs) and checking for index files in directories.
Source-file discovery utilities. Discovers source files under a project root using extensions from the extractor registry, supporting Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and React file types.
Find all source files under a project root by walking the directory tree. Automatically detects supported extensions from the extractor registry, falling back to .py only.
Workflow builder (execution graph). Builds function-level call graph from extracted AST data, supporting both Python and JS/TS files via the extractor registry.
Build the complete function-level call graph (Workflow) by combining static edges, dynamic edges, and import dependencies from all supported source languages.
Re-extract call sites and imports from a source file using the appropriate language extractor (Python AST or JS/TS regex) via the extractor registry.
Build module-to-module import relationships from extracted imports. Handles both Python dot-notation and JS/TS path-based imports without corrupting file extensions.
